lines.t: (Verse 1)
Tracing the lines in the red clay
Still feel the weight of the old ways
We drift like smoke in a hollow room
Before the light broke through the gloom
I held my breath just to feel the ghost
Of the grace I needed the most
(Chorus)
Remember when the sky fell down?
And we were lost before the crown?
You pulled the soul from the deep below
A love so bright it starts to show
I’m breathing now, I’m finally found
On solid ground
(Verse 2)
The pressure climbs in the empty space
I see the scars upon Your face
It’s not a dream, it’s a living fire
Lifting us up from the sinking mire
No more looking back at the hollow years
You washed away the salt of tears
(Bridge)
(Build tension)
It’s moving in...
The light is moving in...
I see it now!
I SEE IT NOW!
Remember when the sky fell down?
And we were lost before the crown?
You pulled the soul from the deep below
A love so bright it starts to show
I’m breathing now, I’m finally found
On solid ground
